title: Entity Framework Core — concept map
intro: Entity Framework Core (EF Core) is the Object-Relational Mapper (ORM) for ASP.NET Core Web APIs. DbContext is scoped per request — not thread-safe. Read paths use AsNoTracking and projection; write paths use tracking and SaveChangesAsync. N+1 queries are fixed with Include, AsSplitQuery, or Select to DTO. Pagination chooses offset vs cursor with total count tradeoffs. RowVersion enables optimistic concurrency returning HTTP 409 Conflict. DbContext is already a unit of work — repository pattern only when abstraction earns its keep.

overviewDiagram.title: EF Core in a Web API request
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  REQ[HTTP Request\nscoped DbContext] --> READ{Read or write?}
  READ -->|GET list/detail| NT[AsNoTracking\nSelect projection]
  READ -->|POST PUT PATCH| TRK[Tracked entities\nSaveChangesAsync]
  NT --> SQL[EF translates LINQ\nto SQL]
  TRK --> SQL
  SQL --> DB[(Database)]
  TRK --> CONC{RowVersion\nconflict?}
  CONC -->|yes| R409[409 Conflict]
  CONC -->|no| OK[200/201]
  REQ --> DISPOSE[Scope disposed\ncontext released]

conceptCards.title: EF Core basics
conceptCards.summary: DbContext + DbSet + LINQ. AddDbContext registers scoped. IQueryable defers to SQL at ToListAsync/FirstOrDefaultAsync. SaveChangesAsync is the commit boundary.

conceptCards.title: DbContext lifetime
conceptCards.summary: Scoped per request, not thread-safe. BackgroundService uses IServiceScopeFactory per work item. ActiveDbContexts ≈ concurrent requests.

conceptCards.title: Tracking vs AsNoTracking
conceptCards.summary: Tracker watches entities for SaveChanges. Read APIs: AsNoTracking or Select DTO. Global NoTracking default with AsTracking on writes.

conceptCards.title: N+1 queries
conceptCards.summary: 1 + N round trips from lazy load or loops. Fix: projection (best), Include, AsSplitQuery for multi-collection.

conceptCards.title: Pagination patterns
conceptCards.summary: Offset Skip/Take simple but slow deep. Cursor/keyset constant time. COUNT expensive — omit, cache, or approximate.

conceptCards.title: Optimistic concurrency
conceptCards.summary: RowVersion in UPDATE WHERE. DbUpdateConcurrencyException → 409 Conflict. Client reloads and retries.

conceptCards.title: Repository vs DbContext
conceptCards.summary: DbContext is unit of work — direct injection default. Domain repo for complex queries. Avoid generic IRepository<T>.
